intro: Iverron's Antidote is a delicate medicinal draught concocted by Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen. Specially brewed to neutralize the lethal venom of the local Webwood spiders, the mixture is highly unstable and spoils rapidly once prepared.

p: Crafted by Dirania Silvershine in Aldrassil, this antidote is formulated to counteract the potent venom afflicting the young night elf Iverron. Due to the volatile nature of its ingredients and herbal catalysts, the draught possesses an exceptionally short shelf life, remaining viable for only five minutes after brewing. Courier messengers must sprint north toward the Webwood cave without delay to deliver the concoction before it degrades into useless slurry.
